reportedFailure.failure: The test required every default stamp to use the ElizaWy terrain_summer sheet after the approved OGA LPC structural-cliff provider was promoted.

rootCause.summary: The unit test encoded the retired single-provider stamp policy instead of the current approved multi-provider production registry.

acceptance: The default stamp registry resolves lpc_pond_grass_bank_a from the havenwild_objects pack and the ElizaWy terrain_summer sheet.
The default stamp registry resolves oga_lpc.cliff.ladder from the oga_lpc_cliffs pack and the promoted grass-top cliff sheet.
The regression test accepts Windows and POSIX source-path separators.
The old all-stamps-must-use-terrain_summer assertion is absent.
No runtime, editor, terrain, save, asset license, or source-pixel behavior changes are introduced.
